questions.question: What are Yuji Itadori's named cursed techniques?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori
questions.note: Added 2026-08-15 by the bank expansion. Shape `charset`. Yuji's named cursed techniques. Corrected 2026-08-17: `Divergent Fist` and `Black Flash` removed, on the wiki's own evidence. Both pages carry `type = Taijutsu`, against `Inherited Technique` on `Blood Manipulation`, `Innate Technique` on `Shrine` and `Extension Technique` on `Convergence` and `Piercing Blood`. A cursed technique is engraved or inherited and run on cursed energy. Divergent Fist is a way of applying cursed energy to a punch, producing a delayed second impact, and Black Flash is a phenomenon anyone with precise enough timing produces rather than something Yuji possesses. Both remain gold on `jjk-char-01`, `Every ability of Yuji Itadori`, where the wider claim is the right one. Same correction as `jjk-set-12`.
